name: MonarchMultiSelect
title: MultiSelect
wrapsNative: Button field that presents a .sheet with a NavigationStack, a List of toggling Buttons and .searchable(text:placement:prompt:); the picks are MonarchTag views in a MonarchFlowLayout
summary: A field for choosing several values from a long list, searched in a sheet, with the chosen values shown as removable tags.
whenToUse: For several choices out of more options than fit as checkboxes, such as labels, people or apps, especially options loaded from a server.
whenNotToUse: Not for a short list where every option should be visible (use MonarchCheckboxGroup), not for free-form values (use MonarchTagInput), and not for one value (use MonarchCombobox or Picker).
api: init(_ label: String, selection: Binding<[String]>, options: [MonarchComboboxOption], prompt: String? = nil, helper: String? = nil, error: String? = nil, maxSelections: Int? = nil, isRequired: Bool = false, isLoading: Bool = false, sortsByMatch: Bool = false, limit: Int? = nil, searchText: Binding<String>? = nil, labels: MonarchMultiSelectLabels = MonarchMultiSelectLabels(), filter: (@Sendable (MonarchComboboxOption, String) -> Bool)? = nil, onCreate: (@MainActor (String) -> MonarchComboboxOption?)? = nil)

struct MonarchMultiSelectLabels: Sendable { init(select: String? = nil, change: String? = nil, done: String? = nil, count: (@Sendable (Int, Int) -> String)? = nil, list: MonarchComboboxLabels = MonarchComboboxLabels()) }

options.name: label
options.description: The visible label, already localised. It names the field and is the title of the sheet.

options.name: selection
options.description: The ids of the chosen options, in the order they were picked.

options.name: options
options.description: The options in order, with the same fields as a combobox option: label, description, hint, group, keywords, systemImage and isDisabled.

options.name: prompt
options.description: The button's text while nothing is chosen. "Select…" when nil.

options.name: helper
options.description: Help text under the field, also read as the hint.

options.name: error
options.description: An error message, shown with an icon and announced.

options.name: maxSelections
options.description: The most values that can be chosen. Other rows are disabled at the limit and "2 of 3 selected" shows under the field and in the list.

options.name: isRequired
options.description: Shows a mark after the label and adds "Required" to the hint.

options.name: isLoading
options.description: Shows a progress row with "Loading…" in the list.

options.name: sortsByMatch
options.description: Lists labels that start with the search first, then labels with a word that does.

options.name: limit
options.description: Shows at most this many matches, with a note to keep typing.

options.name: searchText
options.description: The search text, for a server search. Kept inside when nil; cleared when the sheet closes.

options.name: labels
options.description: Replacements for the built-in strings; `list` takes the combobox list strings.

options.name: filter
options.description: Decides whether an option matches. By default the label, hint and keywords are searched, ignoring case and accents.

options.name: onCreate
options.description: Offers "Create “text”" when no label equals the typed text and the limit is not reached. The returned option is chosen.

states.name: empty
states.description: No tags; the button shows the prompt in the subtle text colour.

states.name: chosen
states.description: The picks are tags with remove buttons inside the field, on the same row as the chevron that opens the list; the chevron is spoken as "Edit selection".

states.name: limit reached
states.description: Rows that are not chosen are disabled in the list and Create is not offered; chosen rows can still be removed.

states.name: loading
states.description: The list shows a progress row with "Loading…".

states.name: error
states.description: The border takes the danger colour and the message shows under the field with an icon.

states.name: disabled
states.description: Text takes the disabled colours and the button and tag remove buttons do nothing.

appearance: The field has the input background and border of a text field, with neutral tags inside. Chosen rows have an accent-strong check mark. In dark and high-contrast themes the same roles resolve to their theme values; the error border and text use the danger-strong role.
platformNotes: The web opens a popover listbox under an input with chips; on iPhone the list opens in a sheet with the system search field, as in Mail or Reminders pickers, and the chips sit above a button. The web submits values as hidden form inputs (`name`); a SwiftUI app reads the binding instead. Android uses the same name and a bottom sheet. Several closures are optional (filter, onCreate). Pass each one with its label: Swift gives a single unlabelled trailing closure to the first parameter that accepts it, which is filter.
accessibility: The button is one element labelled with the field's label; its value is the chosen labels joined with commas, or "None".
The hint reads the error ("Error: …"), the help text, "Required" and the count, each when present.
Each tag is read with its text and has its own "Remove <text>" button.
In the sheet each row is a button read with its label, description and hint; chosen rows have the selected trait and a check mark.
Rows, the button and the tag remove buttons are at least 44 points high.
edgeCases: A chosen id that is not in options shows a label remembered from an earlier list, or the raw id.
Long labels wrap inside the tags and the rows; the tags wrap onto more lines.
With maxSelections of 0 nothing can be chosen.
The search text is cleared when the sheet closes.

examples.title: In a Field, controlled
examples.template:
MonarchMultiSelect(
    {{label}},
    selection: $labels,
    options: [
        MonarchComboboxOption(id: {{options.0.value}}, label: {{options.0.label}}),
        MonarchComboboxOption(id: {{options.1.value}}, label: {{options.1.label}}),
        MonarchComboboxOption(id: {{options.2.value}}, label: {{options.2.label}}),
        MonarchComboboxOption(id: {{options.3.value}}, label: {{options.3.label}}),
        MonarchComboboxOption(id: {{options.4.value}}, label: {{options.4.label}}),
        MonarchComboboxOption(id: {{options.5.value}}, label: {{options.5.label}}),
    ],
    prompt: {{placeholder}},
    helper: {{description}}
)
examples.code:
MonarchMultiSelect(
    "Labels",
    selection: $labels,
    options: [
        MonarchComboboxOption(id: "bug", label: "Bug"),
        MonarchComboboxOption(id: "design", label: "Design"),
        MonarchComboboxOption(id: "docs", label: "Documentation"),
        MonarchComboboxOption(id: "perf", label: "Performance"),
        MonarchComboboxOption(id: "security", label: "Security"),
        MonarchComboboxOption(id: "support", label: "Support"),
    ],
    prompt: "Add labels",
    helper: "Type to filter. Picked labels show as chips."
)

examples.title: Required, with an error
examples.code:
MonarchMultiSelect(
    "Areas",
    selection: $areas,
    options: [
        MonarchComboboxOption(id: "web", label: "Web"),
        MonarchComboboxOption(id: "ios", label: "iOS"),
    ],
    error: areas.isEmpty ? "Choose at least one area." : nil,
    isRequired: true
)
